motion_model.initialization: first state only; unknown first-command prehistory held constant
limitations: No unique physical Kt, inertia split, gear stiffness, backlash width, or internal three-loop reconstruction.
Current frozen parameters were transferred across recorded gains and motions; finite historical validation is not global stability or TS20-100 qualification.
Additional known inertia cannot be added directly to J_total_over_ka without the unknown physical scale ka.
Blocked-output geometry and backlash are not represented by this free-motion model.

parameter_write_scope: Exact reviewed estimator/PID profile; other actual MC/MPC gains protected; restore original typed values after landing

diagnostic_parameters.tuning_claim: Finite local candidate comparison only; no claim of global or fully tuned optimum
diagnostic_parameters.origin_semantics: Raw EV NED observation has [world_y, world_x, -world_z]; with zero EV/IMU offsets, no GNSS position fusion resets EKF local XY to [world_y, world_x]. EV height reference resets global altitude to world_z, retaining an existing origin altitude: local_z=ref_alt-world_z. Require live frame bridge checks; old GPS/world geodetic mapping is not a valid precision-mode target conversion.

restore_storage_save.semantics: Pinned param.cpp save without path calls do_save_default -> param_save_default(true); exit 0 means synchronous success

causal_joint_provider: while upper estimated feedback is active: one estimator-clock selection; physical q and modeled endpoint dq; same opaque observation binds MPC context
raw_ros_joint_role: while causal upper provider is active: independent recording diagnostic, not upper joint/control or physical-monitor clock; recorder health faults still reject evidence. Non-upper commissioning retains its original physical-feedback clock.
future_upper_command_timing_assumption: new upper velocity is modeled at current control snapshot time; actual future compute/ROS consumption lag is not predicted
